column1: # GNU DEFUNs a Romacs session leaves undefined: NAME<TAB>STATUS<TAB>NOTE, sorted by name.
# STATUS needed (a command or called by shipped Lisp: to implement; NOTE says by whom),
# elsewhere (in progress in another lane; NOTE says which), or absent (deliberately left out;
# NOTE is the reason).  crates/romacs-vm-gui/src/defun_census.rs keeps it exact: a name the
# world defines must leave, a newly undefined DEFUN must come in.
